fields.value: Dataset: Regeneration of iron species for high and stable activity of Ni electrodes in the oxygen evolution reaction

dsDescriptionValue.value:
The dataset contains the raw data of the experiments performed for the scientific article "Regeneration of iron species for high and stable activity of Ni electrodes in the oxygen evolution reaction".
The dataset contains data from: electrochemical measurements, TOF-SIMS and XPS.
The electrochemical data was measured with Gamry potentiostat (.DTA) but they can also be opened by Microsoft Excel or a Notepad (instructions on how to open the data are present).

publicationCitation.value:
Poli S, Poleunis C, Miola M, Gerlach D, Rudolf P, Delcorte A, Lammers H, de Groot MT, Morales DM, Pescarmona PP. Regeneration of iron species for high and stable activity of nickel electrodes in the oxygen evolution reaction. Green Chem. 2025 Apr 11. doi: 10.1039/d5gc00114e.
